skills.name: Application Performance Monitoring with OpenTelemetry
skills.description: Initialize and configure a LocalStreamEnvironment for in-process Flink program development, enabling IDE-based debugging and breakpoint inspection.
skills.skill_body:
Create a LocalStreamEnvironment using StreamExecutionEnvironment.createLocalEnvironment(). This starts a Flink system within the same JVM process, allowing you to set breakpoints in your code and debug your program directly from an IDE. After initialization, add data sources using env.addSource() or collection-based sources like env.fromElements() or env.fromCollection(), build your program logic and transformations on the DataStream, then call env.execute() to run it locally.

## Objective

Enable local development and debugging of Flink streaming programs
## Applicable Signals

- Development phase initiated
- Local testing required
- Debugging needed before production deployment

## Contraindications

- Running production workloads
- Testing distributed fault tolerance
- Requiring multi-node cluster behavior
- Performance testing at scale

## Workflow Steps

- Call StreamExecutionEnvironment.createLocalEnvironment() to instantiate the environment
- Add data sources using env.addSource() for external sources or env.fromElements()/env.fromCollection() for test data
- Build program logic and transformations on the DataStream
- Call env.execute() to run the program locally
- Set breakpoints in IDE and inspect execution state as needed

## Constraints

- Execution occurs within a single JVM process
- Not suitable for testing distributed system interactions
- Limited to local machine resources

## Output Contract

- LocalStreamEnvironment instance created and ready to accept data sources
- Program executes within IDE with breakpoint capability
- Results available for inspection and debugging
